column1: # 当前认证 transport 事实：access/refresh 的产生、发送、存储与消费；Bearer/body/cookie 实际入口与反证。
# 层次：SOURCE_STATIC_REVIEW（当前文件行号 + SHA256）。本轮真实 JWT/IDB/UI 验证 NOT_RUN。
# 注意：cookie 旗标不能替代真实 transport 来源（COMMON_RULES §4；PC01）。

column2: JWT signed by signAccessToken(user) with {userId,systemRole}, TTL from JWT_ACCESS_TTL/TTL_SEC or 900s default
column6: Bearer access token; payload carries only userId+systemRole (no permission array)

column2: accessToken=signAccessToken(authenticatedUser); returned in /login JSON with token field (legacy compat)
request interceptor reads tokenStore.getAccessToken() and sets Authorization: Bearer <token> on every request
column6: Bearer header is the sole access-token transport

column2: authenticate() reads Authorization Bearer, jwt.verify, loads user, checks status=ACTIVE; sets c.auth
tokenStore.setTokens writes rdpms.accessToken + rdpms.refreshToken to localStorage
column6: localStorage is the only token store

column2: issueRefreshToken: random 48-byte hex, sha256 stored, random familyId, 7d default TTL
column7: familyId is random per issue; no generation/version

column2: POST /auth/refresh with JSON body {refreshToken}; raw axios bypassing shared interceptor
/refresh reads tokenHash, rejects revoked/expired/non-ACTIVE; revokes old, signs new access, issues new random-family refresh
column6: server unconditionally revokes old token and creates successor
column7: two concurrent tabs can each create a successor under interleaving (R02)

column2: refreshAccessToken writes response to tokenStore.setTokens without checking initiator
column6: token pair stored globally, no actor/session-generation guard
column7: late success can overwrite another user's pair (OBS-04)

column2: No Set-Cookie / withCredentials found in bounded frontend/backend auth path; CORS credentials:true does NOT establish cookie auth
column6: cookie is NOT a supported auth transport
column7: CORS credentials flag + deployment cookie flags are config, not cookie auth implementation

column2: VITE_API_BASE_URL (default /api) configures frontend API root; JWT_ACCESS_TTL/TTL_SEC and JWT_REFRESH_TTL configure lifetimes
column6: config does not change transport shape (Bearer/body)
